title: jmri-json-loconetSlotUsage-server-message
description: Data portion of message from JMRI to client for type "loconetSlotUsage"

commandStation.description: Name of the detected LocoNet command station type, e.g. "DCS52", or null if not yet detected

used.description: Number of real loco slots currently in use (not free) on the command station

total.description: Total number of real loco slots on the connected command station

free.description: Number of real loco slots currently free (total minus used)
